note: The steps of `genko studio` for test_cli_e2e's studioCommandLineAsProcesses (the command line's job of service_cases.json of c12298b0): each a process of its own in the root ($root), with GENKO_USER and a config folder of its own; a step {write, text | base64} writes a file under the root first. Each process ends in time without crashing with the exit code given (0, 1 or 3; 2 only for arguments the command line does not take), and prints one JSON object or nothing. The last step takes leases on two work items (next with claim): each held for 600 s from then.

steps.text:
{
  "scenes": [
    {
      "id": "sc_01",
      "summary": "ひなが屋上に上がる",
      "location_id": "loc_rooftop",
      "time": "sunset",
      "beats": [
        {
          "id": "b01",
          "kind": "action",
          "speaker_id": null,
          "text": "夕方の屋上。ひなが扉を開ける",
          "emotion": "緊張",
          "page": 1,
          "reveal": false
        },
        {
          "id": "b02",
          "kind": "narration",
          "speaker_id": null,
          "text": "5年前の今日、ここで約束した",
          "emotion": "郷愁",
          "page": 1,
          "reveal": false
        },
        {
          "id": "b03",
          "kind": "monologue",
          "speaker_id": "hina",
          "text": "…来るわけないよね",
          "emotion": "諦め",
          "page": 1,
          "reveal": false
        },
        {
          "id": "b04",
          "kind": "action",
          "speaker_id": null,
          "text": "誰もいない屋上。フェンスの向こうに夕日",
          "emotion": "寂しさ",
          "page": 2,
          "reveal": false
        },
        {
          "id": "b05",
          "kind": "dialogue",
          "speaker_id": "sora",
          "text": "遅いぞ",
          "emotion": "照れ",
          "page": 2,
          "reveal": true
        },
        {
          "id": "b06",
          "kind": "action",
          "speaker_id": null,
          "text": "給水塔の上にソラが座っている",
          "emotion": "驚き",
          "page": 2,
          "reveal": false
        },
        {
          "id": "b07",
          "kind": "dialogue",
          "speaker_id": "hina",
          "text": "…やっぱり来てくれたんだ",
          "emotion": "安堵",
          "page": 3,
          "reveal": false
        },
        {
          "id": "b08",
          "kind": "dialogue",
          "speaker_id": "sora",
          "text": "約束しただろ",
          "emotion": "照れ",
          "page": 3,
          "reveal": false
        },
        {
          "id": "b09",
          "kind": "dialogue",
          "speaker_id": "hina",
          "text": "うん…約束したから",
          "emotion": "喜び",
          "page": 4,
          "reveal": false
        },
        {
          "id": "b10",
          "kind": "action",
          "speaker_id": null,
          "text": "二人並んで夕日を見る",
          "emotion": "静けさ",
          "page": 4,
          "reveal": false
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
